item.title: Mail-in voters consider flying to vote in person amid postal uncertainty
item.description: With legal battles over USPS mail-in voting, voters and officials are exploring backup plans for the midterms.

item.title: Comic: Can love survive conflict? Honest questions about fighting

item.title: Flight data indicates cargo jet attempted to abort unstable landing before Miami crash
item.description: Data suggests an Amazon cargo plane tried to abort an unstable landing at Miami International Airport before hitting a van, killing five.
